TermTranslation.definition: A test that uses a lighted magnifying tool to examine the vulva, vagina and cervix.
Cells that are changing their size, shape and organization within tissue and are likely to become cancer cells.
A test that scrapes cells from the cervix and looks at them under a microscope.
A physical exam that checks for changes in a woman’s reproductive organs, including the uterus, cervix, ovaries and vagina.
Can become cancer or is likely to become cancer.

The organs in the body involved in reproducing children. In women, the reproductive organs are the ovaries, Fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix and vagina. In men, they are the testicles, prostate and penis.
The organ in a woman’s body that holds and nourishes the baby during pregnancy.
